title: Instant Pot Baby Back Ribs
description: Tender Instant Pot baby back ribs made with spice-rubbed pork ribs cooked in a pressure cooker and brushed with BBQ sauce until sticky and delicious.
ingredients: 0.25 cup barbeque sauce, or as needed

steps.text: Combine kosher salt, brown sugar, chili powder, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Cut rib rack into 4 equal portions; rub all sides each portion with spice mixture.

Pour broth into a multi-functional pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot). Add ribs in a teepee formation. Close and lock the lid. Select high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions; set timer for 30 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.

Release pressure carefully using the quick-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, about 5 minutes. Unlock and remove the lid. Transfer ribs to the prepared baking sheet. Brush ribs on all sides with barbecue sauce.

Bake in the preheated oven for 7 minutes. Flip ribs; continue baking until meat easily pulls away from the bones, about 7 minutes more. An instant-read thermometer inserted into center should read 145 degrees F (63 degrees C).

video.description: These are seasoned to perfection. Your Instant Pot does all the work for these fall off the bone ribs. Add some tangy barbecue sauce and bake for 15 minutes! Simple, satisfying, and savory.
